## Company

SHOEfabrik is an international footwear development, sourcing, and manufacturing company. It has worked with leading global footwear brands for more than 20 years. The company is 100% European-capitalized.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Manager
- **Experience:** Around 3 to 6 years of relevant professional experience (preferred)
- **Skills:** ERP, Microsoft 365, Power BI

## Responsibilities

This role is not simply PLM administration. The PLM Systems Manager will help implement Centric PLM, train teams, improve how people use the system, and ensure the information in it is accurate and useful. The role also includes turning that information into better reports, dashboards, and business decisions. Over time, the person will become the main internal owner of Centric PLM across SHOEfabrik.

Key responsibilities include:

- Help manage the implementation of Centric PLM.
- Coordinate actions between SHOEfabrik teams and Centric Software.
- Track open issues, changes, decisions, and deadlines.
- Support system testing and new releases.
- Train users and provide day-to-day support.
- Create clear training material.
- Improve system views, forms, and workflows.
- Help teams use Centric correctly.
- Monitor data quality and identify recurring problems.
- Build useful reports and dashboards.
- Use Excel, Power BI, and other tools to analyse PLM data.
- Help management see delays, exceptions, bottlenecks, and other important information.
- Explore practical ways to use AI to analyse exports, summarise information, and identify patterns.
- Continue to improve the system after the main implementation is complete.

**Footwear data:** The role involves learning how information moves through the SHOEfabrik product creation process, including:

- Styles and seasons
- Colourways
- Materials and components
- Product specifications
- Samples
- Costing
- Development status
- Suppliers and factories
- Approvals and changes
- Key development dates

**Collaboration:** The role works with Product Creation, Development, Engineering, Costing, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and management.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Personal attributes:**

- Exceptionally organised, with clear action tracking and consistent follow-up
- Notices when information is missing and enjoys creating order around complex work
- Technically confident and curious, with an interest in learning new systems and finding better ways to use them
- Comfortable working with data and interested in what the information means, not only in producing reports
- Calm and patient, able to explain technical subjects in simple language and help users of varying learning speeds become confident
- Able to learn quickly; does not need to know everything on day one

**Ideally, the candidate has:**

- Around 3 to 6 years of relevant professional experience
- Experience with PLM, ERP, PDM, MES, or another enterprise business system
- Strong Excel skills
- Experience with data, reporting, or dashboards
- Experience with business processes
- Experience supporting or training users
- Strong written and spoken English

**Advantageous (not essential):**

- Centric PLM experience
- Footwear, apparel, product development, sourcing, or manufacturing experience
- Experience with Power BI, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools

**Possible backgrounds:** Candidates may already work in PLM or come from business systems, ERP, business analysis, data and reporting, manufacturing systems, process improvement, digital operations, or technology consulting.

**Preference:** Strong local talent who understands the Vietnamese working environment and is comfortable working in an international company.

## Benefits

- 20 days of annual leave per year

## Company

VIVAS (Công ty TNHH Cung cấp Giải pháp Dịch vụ Giá trị Gia tăng) is a Vietnamese software company that provides value-added service solutions. It operates in the software industry and has 100–499 employees.

- **Position:** Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Kỹ sư Quản lý Chất lượng Phần mềm)
- **Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Openings:** 1
- **Experience:** No experience required
- **Salary:** 8 to 15 million VND
- **Work model:** On-site, full-time, Monday to Friday
- **Probation period:** 2 months

## Responsibilities

- Read and analyze business documents, system design documents, and product requirements to define the testing scope.
- Take part in requirements analysis and document reviews to identify risks and quality issues early.
- Prepare testing documentation, including Test Plans, Test Cases/Checklists, Test Scripts, and Test Data.
- Test systems and services on Web, Mobile, and API platforms.
- Perform the following types of testing: Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke Testing, Integration Testing, and UAT Support.
- Analyze test results and assess product quality, including functional correctness, system stability, performance, and user experience.
- Detect, log, track, and work with the development team to resolve software defects.
- Propose feature improvements to enhance user experience and product quality.
- Prepare test reports and quality reports, and track defect metrics before and after improvements to evaluate their effectiveness.
- Help create user guides, operational documentation, and user training materials.
- Coordinate with Business Analysts (BA), Developers (Dev), and Product Owners/Project Managers (PO/PM) throughout product development and deployment.
- Research and improve testing processes and adopt testing tools.

- Knowledge of software development lifecycles and software testing processes.
- Ability to read and write Test Plans, Test Cases, Test Checklists, and Bug Reports.
- Understanding of software testing levels, such as Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Functional Testing, and System Testing.

## Details

- **Location:** Cầu Giấy District, Hanoi
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior specialist (Chuyên viên cấp cao)
- **Experience:** 3–5 years

## Responsibilities

- Operate and maintain Information Security (InfoSec) systems and solutions to ensure stable performance.
- Optimize configurations and security policies to improve operational efficiency and reduce risk.
- Coordinate with internal units and partners to deploy, troubleshoot, and upgrade InfoSec systems.
- Participate in risk assessments, compliance checks, and propose improvements to security solutions.
- Prepare operating documentation, incident-handling procedures, administration procedures, and InfoSec-related reports.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Experience**

- At least 3–5 years of experience in operating Information Security systems.
- Priority will be given to candidates with experience in financial institutions, banks, or organizations with high security and compliance requirements.
- Hands-on experience operating, monitoring, optimizing, and troubleshooting the following solutions:
  - PAM (Privileged Access Management)
  - NAC (Network Access Control)
  - WAF (Web Application Firewall)
  - Proxy / Secure Web Gateway
  - EDR/XDR
  - Patch Management
  - Antivirus/Anti-malware
  - SIEM/SOC or other security monitoring solutions

**Technical Knowledge**

- Strong knowledge of:
  - Networking: TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, proxy
  - Windows and Linux operating systems and access control models
  - Information security models, standards, and principles
- Ability to analyze logs, investigate, and handle security incidents.
- Operational mindset, system optimization skills, and strong ability to coordinate incident response.

**Certifications and Preferred Qualifications**

- Preferred international InfoSec certifications such as CEH, Security+, CySA+, CISSP, CISM, CCNA Security, or equivalent.
- Technical or expert certifications from security vendors are an advantage.
- Preference for candidates with hands-on experience operating security solutions in financial or banking environments or large enterprises.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary in line with the market.
- Performance bonuses based on business results and job completion; collective and individual outstanding-performance bonuses; ad hoc bonuses; and holiday and Tết bonuses for employees.
- Full social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance in accordance with the Labor Law, plus Pijico health insurance with enhanced benefits.
- Other benefits: annual company trip, birthday gifts, support for illness, weddings, and maternity.
- Access to PGBank training programs and practical on-the-job experience support.
- A supportive, collaborative, and efficient work environment.
- Fair opportunities for development and career advancement.

description:
## Company

MBBANK is a Vietnamese commercial bank. This role is in its Digital Banking division, which supports the integration of partner services with the bank's systems.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi
- **Level:** Specialist (Chuyên viên)

## Responsibilities

**I. Partner Service Integration Support**

- Receive partner information, service scope, integration plans, and points of contact.
- Guide partners on integration documentation, APIs, connection procedures, security requirements, and the bank's technical and business conditions.
- Prepare or coordinate the creation of test data, ensuring that data is complete, valid, and suitable before it is provided.
- Guide partners through implementation steps, input/output requirements, and required documentation; help resolve obstacles and coordinate with stakeholders to respond promptly.
- Manage test data to ensure it is used in the correct environment and complies with security regulations, and do not use real customer data without approval.

**II. Integration Progress, Testing, and Acceptance Management**

- Create and update integration plans for each partner or service; track progress, identify delayed tasks, their causes, and related responsibilities.
- Consolidate progress reports, risks, and bottlenecks, and propose solutions.
- Analyze test data requirements and prepare data covering success flows, exception cases, and boundary conditions.
- Monitor the execution of test scenarios; record results, errors found, remediation plans, and coordinate re-testing after fixes.
- Review acceptance results and documentation; coordinate confirmation that conditions are met before recommending go-live.

**III. Go-Live Checklist, Deployment, and Post-Deployment Monitoring**

- Coordinate the go-live plan with partners and related units, including timing, on-duty personnel, tasks, and communication arrangements.
- Review the pre-go-live checklist: acceptance results, production configuration, access rights, connectivity, security controls, and required approvals.
- Coordinate post-go-live checks, confirm the service operates within the approved scope, and hand it over to the operations unit.
- Ensure production deployment complies with the bank's approval process, change control, and information security requirements.
- Monitor the service after go-live; receive and coordinate the handling of issues that arise.
- Update progress reports, completion rates, causes of delays, and remediation plans.
- Maintain complete and compliant records of integration documentation, test results, acceptance minutes, go-live checklists, and related files.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- University degree or higher in IT, Information Systems, Finance and Banking, Economics, or a related field.
- 1–3 years of experience in system/API integration, technology deployment, project management, partner support, or digital product operations.
- Preferred: experience at a bank, fintech, payment intermediary, or banking technology company; understanding of or experience with banking operations, payments, API Banking, Open Banking/BaaS, testing, and service deployment.
- Experience in testing, acceptance, and production deployment; preference for candidates who have worked as a Tester/QA, prepared test data, or performed API testing.
- Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English and use office software for planning, tracking, and reporting.
- Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, system integration flows, Test/UAT/Production environments, and error handling.
- Testing mindset, with the ability to create and manage test cases and test data; preference for candidates with experience testing APIs using Postman or equivalent tools.
- Careful, proactive, and responsible in managing documentation, reporting, and task tracking.

## Benefits

- **Bonuses:** Holiday and Tết bonuses; performance bonuses linked to individual performance and business results.
- **Health insurance:** Healthcare coverage for employees and their dependents, with additional privileges.
- **Travel:** Annual domestic and international travel or retreat programs.
- **Life milestones:** Support for important moments, such as birthday leave and wedding gifts.
- **Employee engagement:** Birthday gifts, Lunar New Year gifts, and seniority-based recognition.
- **Financial services:** Advisory and financial support, and access to the group's personal financial and insurance products.
- **Career development:** Clear career progression paths and development opportunities across the bank's professional groups.

description:
## Company

WeCare Group (CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN WECARE GROUP) is a B2B distributor of industrial supplies in Vietnam. It sells industrial hardware and consumables, including fasteners, welding materials, adhesives, packaging film, pipes and fittings, and metal hardware, from a catalog of thousands of SKUs. Its customers are hardware shops nationwide and manufacturing factories. The company purchases from suppliers, holds its own inventory, and delivers to business customers across the country. It processes over 100,000 orders per month.

The company is rebuilding its core ERP platform from a legacy low-code stack to a cloud-native system on Google Cloud Platform.

## Details

- **Location:** Lô 14-16-18-20, Đường số 36, Phường Bình Phú, TP. Hồ Chí Minh (Ho Chi Minh City)
- **Level:** Senior / Team Lead / Senior Specialist; 5+ years of experience
- **Work model:** On-site, with 1 work-from-home day per month
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00; Saturday, 08:00 to 12:00

## Responsibilities

This is a foundational hire for Phase 1 of the ERP rebuild. You will own the entire cloud foundation and co-architect the engineering harness (CI/CD, automated verification gates, and AI-assisted delivery pipelines) alongside the R&D Lead. The platform decisions you make will shape the system architecture for years to come.

- Design and manage the GCP landing zone, project structure, VPC, IAM (following the least-privilege principle), and multi-tier environments.
- Own end-to-end infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ensuring 100% reproducibility with zero manual or hand-configured setups.
- Build and optimize GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, integrated with rigorous verification gates to maintain high code quality at AI-accelerated delivery speeds.
- Manage Cloud SQL, including provisioning, HA/DR, automated backups, and migration safety. Establish Cloud Run deployment patterns with Pub/Sub messaging.
- Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLA/SLO tracking using GCP-native tools and/or Datadog.
- Establish the security baseline, including RBAC, Secret Manager integration, and audit logging.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Information Security.
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Infrastructure, Platform, or DevOps roles, with demonstrated production experience on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, IAM, VPC).
- Production-grade Terraform experience.
- Advanced CI/CD pipeline design and operation.
- Solid PostgreSQL database operations and migration management.
- Fluent English, required for writing Architecture Decision Records

description:
## Company

ANTSOMI is a data and marketing technology company. Its products include a Customer Data Platform (CDP) and related data solutions for enterprise customers.

## Details

- **Location:** Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior (Chuyên viên cấp cao), 4 years' experience

## Responsibilities

This is a senior, hands-on, customer-facing role that combines data integration, automation, analytics, troubleshooting, and consulting. You will lead complex data engagements, advise enterprise clients, and help develop scalable Data Services capabilities across the organization. You will work with complex customer data ecosystems spanning systems such as CRM, POS, Ecommerce, Loyalty, ERP, Billing, Data Warehouses, and third-party SaaS platforms.

### 1. Data Integration & Workflow Automation

- Lead the design and implementation of enterprise data integrations between Antsomi and customer systems.
- Design and build automated workflows using n8n, Apache Airflow, or similar workflow orchestration platforms.
- Design and operate reliable ETL/ELT workflows and production data pipelines.
- Integrate data through REST APIs, Webhooks, databases, SFTP, batch files, cloud storage, and other integration methods.
- Define appropriate integration patterns, including API-based, scheduled, batch, file-based, and event-driven integrations.
- Design workflow scheduling, dependencies, retries, timeout handling, logging, alerting, and recovery mechanisms.
- Define data extraction, transformation, mapping, and loading logic across multiple enterprise systems.
- Work with enterprise data domains such as Customer, Transaction, Product, Subscription, Loyalty, Campaign, and Behavioral/Event data.
- Lead data migration and historical data ingestion when required.
- Review existing integrations and recommend improvements for reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
- Own complex integration delivery from Design → Build → Test → Go-live → Monitor → Optimize.

### 2. Data Mapping, Quality & Governance

- Analyze complex source system data models and define source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, transformation rules, and integration specifications.
- Define and implement data validation and reconciliation frameworks.
- Establish data quality rules covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, duplication, validity, and freshness.
- Design reusable and automated data quality checks.
- Lead reconciliation between customer source systems, Antsomi platforms, and downstream reporting.
- Investigate complex data discrepancies across multiple systems and integration layers.

title: [Hanoi] Senior Automation & AI System Engineer
description:
## Company

Zeder Corporation (ZEDER VIỆT NAM) runs an Automation and AI team in Hanoi that builds process automation across its business systems, including NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics Navision, Magento 2, Freshsales, Freshdesk, Stripe, Google BigQuery, Twilio and Asana. The team works directly with English-speaking stakeholders in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.

## Details

- **Location:** Hà Đông District, Hanoi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior (Chuyên viên cấp cao)
- **Openings:** 2

## Responsibilities

The role is a senior, hands-on engineering position. You will take a business problem, scope it with the people who own the process, and then build and ship the solution yourself. The work spans three areas: conventional automation and system integration, agentic automation, and LLM-assisted automation. A large part of the job is knowing which of the three a given problem calls for.

### Scoping and Requirements

- Meet with department stakeholders to understand the process, the problem and the outcome they actually need.
- Map current-state processes and identify where automation delivers real value rather than automating waste.
- Write clear scoping documents covering requirements, proposed approach, systems and data involved, effort estimate and success measures.
- Recommend the right approach for each project, whether a platform workflow, an agentic system, an LLM-assisted step or a code solution.
- Push back on requests where automation is not the right answer, and explain your reasoning.

### Engineering and Delivery

- Build, test and deploy automations end to end, from approved scope through to production and handover.
- Design integrations across our systems using REST APIs, webhooks and file-based transfers, including authentication, rate limiting, pagination, retries and data mapping.
- Write production JavaScript and Python for logic that a platform cannot handle properly.
- Build systems that hold up in production: idempotent operations, sensible retry and backoff, queueing, dead-letter handling, and failure states that alert someone rather than failing silently.
- Model and manage the data behind multi-step processes, including state, queues and reconciliation.
- Work with the existing stack: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics Navision, Magento 2, Freshsales, Freshdesk, Stripe, Google BigQuery, Twilio and Asana.

### Tooling

- Build on n8n, the primary automation platform, wherever the platform can genuinely do the job. Platform-based workflows must be visible, supportable and maintainable by more than one person.
- Write code only when the platform is the wrong tool. Any code you write must be production-grade: version controlled, documented, tested and deployable by someone other than you.

### AI and Agentic Systems

- Build agentic workflows that combine planning, tool use and decision-making using LLMs.
- Integrate LLMs into business processes for classification, extraction, summarisation, document routing, drafting and decision support.
- Treat prompts as production assets: versioned, tested, and managed with attention to context, structured outputs and tool definitions.
- Manage agent memory and state across multi-step actions. Design guardrails, validation and human review points where the cost of an error is high.
- Evaluate output quality using a defined method rather than impression, and monitor it after launch.
- Treat token cost and latency as first-class design constraints.
- Recognise when an LLM is the wrong tool and use ordinary code instead.

### Reliability, Documentation and Support

- Own the reliability of what you build, including monitoring, logging, alerting and error handling.
- Maintain technical documentation and runbooks in Confluence so others can support the automations

title: Remote Data Engineer - AI Data Platform Japan (Python)
description:
## Company

SalesNow Inc. is a Japanese company that builds its own B2B sales-intelligence product for the Japanese market. Its platform compiles corporate data from many sources, including company profiles, job postings, investor relations materials, services and technology stacks, advertising, organizational structure, and contact information. It tracks company activity signals such as hiring surges, fundraising, new offices, overseas expansion, forecast cuts, and removed job postings. Customers, mainly sales teams at large companies and listed companies, use this data to decide which companies to approach and when. Data is delivered through the SalesNow web application, Salesforce and HubSpot integrations, a Data API, and an MCP server for AI agents. The company has three Vietnamese team members and plans to hire 5 to 10 more in Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Remote (100% remote, from anywhere with a stable internet connection; no office attendance required)
- **Level:** Not specified (2+ years of professional data engineering experience required)
- **Salary:** 1,000 – 2,500 USD per month (25 – 62 million VND per month), depending on experience and skills
- **Work model:** Full-time, fully remote, employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) with a full local employment contract and local statutory benefits. Core hours are 10:00 – 19:00 Japan time (8:00 – 17:00 Vietnam time), with flextime outside core hours. No change of work location is required.

## Responsibilities

**Data collection and ingestion**
- Design and implement large-scale web scraping systems that reliably extract structured data from many different sources.
- Build API integration pipelines for partner data sources, including schema validation and anomaly detection.
- Design real-time ingestion pipelines for daily updates, with a target latency of under one minute.
- Design and maintain crawling workflows that cover the websites of every company and continuously track changes to them.

**Transformation and data quality**
- Build and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into SalesNow's unified schema.
- Define data quality SLAs (accuracy, completeness, freshness) and build monitoring dashboards and alerts that detect issues before customers do.
- Implement large-scale entity resolution and deduplication, matching company records across sources that use different formats, naming conventions, and identifiers.
- Address the job-closure detection problem: determine whether a job posting is still open or has closed. Closure logic currently spans three systems with different behavior by source. Some sources do not show closure status on listing pages, so diff-based comparison can wrongly mark postings as closed when a crawl fails temporarily.

**Infrastructure and orchestration**
- Orchestrate complex Airflow DAGs across collection, transformation, enrichment, and distribution of data.
- Optimize PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch

- Gather user feedback and continuously refine tools to better meet operational needs.

**4. Quality, Governance & Tooling**

**5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

title: Nhân Viên IPC
description:
## Company

CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN UV is a Vietnamese company in the agriculture industry with 500–999 employees. Its job postings include quality assurance, R&D, and laboratory roles in pharmaceutical chemistry, microbiology, and veterinary science.

## Details

- **Location:** Hồ Chí Minh: Tân Vĩnh Lộc Commune (former Bình Chánh District)
- **Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Working hours:** Monday to Saturday, 08:00–17:00

## Responsibilities

1. **Product quality control in production**
   - Inspect key stages of the production process according to the self-inspection procedure.
   - Check and supervise the implementation of issued procedures.
   - Identify defective semi-finished and finished products, and instruct production workers to rework or repair them, or to halt the production line. Report these cases to the QA Team Leader for handling.
   - Carry out verification and validation plans for production processes and equipment.
   - Update information on changes and adjustments related to products, handling methods for defective products, and similar matters. Check and reconcile this information against production orders.
   - Store information and retention samples for each product batch.
   - Monitor and send finished product samples for quality testing on a periodic basis according to plan.

2. **Handling product-related incidents**
   - **During production:**
     - Coordinate with the QA Team Leader, Technical Management (QLKT), and R&D to handle quality abnormalities that arise during production.
     - Receive information on, or promptly detect, incidents occurring during production, and report them to the QA Team Leader.
     - Coordinate with QLKT to halt production for evaluation and inspection when required.
     - Work with relevant departments to investigate root causes, identify handling solutions, and implement preventive measures.
     - Finalize the handling solution and carry out its implementation.
   - **After production:**
     - Coordinate with the finished product IPC team and R&D to investigate the causes of defects in products that receive customer complaints or are returned from the market.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- University degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmacy, Food Technology, Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine, or Aquaculture.
- Honest, diligent, hardworking, careful, and meticulous.

## Benefits

- Lunch allowance provided by the company (meal worth VND 35,000 plus yogurt).
- Annual birthday gift for employees.
- Support for weddings, funerals, and holidays, among other occasions.
- Tết (Lunar New Year) and holiday bonuses, plus a 13th-month bonus.
- Social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance as required by state regulations. The company also purchases additional 24/7 accident insurance and comprehensive health insurance.
- Annual salary review.
- Comprehensive health insurance for employees' family members.
- Tuition and school supply support for employees' children from Grade 1 to Grade 12.
- Awards for employees' children with outstanding academic achievement.
- Annual company trip.

## Company

CÔNG TY TNHH HỮU TOÀN GROUP is a manufacturing company based in Vietnam with 100–499 employees. The role focuses on generators, alternators, and power generation systems.

## Details

- **Location:** 01 Bach Dang Street, Tan Son Hoa Ward, Ho Chi Minh City (office relocation to District 2 is planned for September 2026)
- **Seniority/Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Experience:** Not required
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, with flexible working hours
- **Work model:** Office-based

## Responsibilities

**Product Development & Innovation**
- Research and develop new generator designs, alternator technologies, and hybrid power systems to enhance performance and efficiency.
- Evaluate and integrate new materials, components, and technologies to improve reliability and sustainability.
- Work on energy smart systems, energy storage, and hybrid solutions (e.g., IoT systems, solar-diesel hybrid, battery backup systems) to align with industry trends.

**Design & Engineering**
- Perform mechanical, electrical, and thermal simulations for power generation systems.
- Design and optimize components such as stator windings, rotor balancing, cooling systems, and fuel efficiency improvements.
- Develop CAD models, electrical schematics, and technical drawings for prototyping and production.

**Testing & Validation**
- Conduct performance tests, durability analysis, and failure investigations of generators and components.
- Define test procedures and ensure compliance with customer requirements and/or industry standards.
- Work with the Quality and Production teams to resolve manufacturing issues and optimize production processes.

**Project Management & Collaboration**
- Manage R&D projects from concept to production, ensuring milestones and deadlines are met.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Quality, Procurement, and Manufacturing) to implement new solutions.
- Engage with key suppliers and partners to explore emerging technologies.

**Documentation & Compliance**
- Prepare technical reports, test results, and design documentation.
- Ensure products meet safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must-have**
- Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience in R&D, product development, or engineering roles in power generation, alternators, or energy solutions is a plus. If you do not have this experience, the company is willing to train you.
- Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or equivalent) and simulation tools (ANSYS, MATLAB, COMSOL, etc.).
- Problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues.
- Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

**Preferred**
- Experience with hybrid power systems, renewable energy integration, and energy storage.
- Knowledge of control systems, embedded programming (PLC, microcontrollers), and automation.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary package with phone, lunch, and transportation allowances.
- Comprehensive health insurance provided by Pjico.
- 14 annual leave days per year.
- 100% salary during the 2-month probation period.
- Direct coaching, training, and mentorship from experienced Engineering professionals.

## Company

## Details

- **Experience:** 2–4 years

## Responsibilities

**3D jewelry modeling and rendering**
- Build highly detailed 3D models of Jemmia's jewelry products, including rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and more, with meticulous attention to form and proportion.
- Design materials (shading) and lighting setups that capture the sparkle, texture, and craftsmanship of gemstones and precious metals.
- Produce photorealistic renders that showcase products at their most beautiful for campaigns, e-commerce, and key brand visuals.

**3D animation**
- Animate product movement with smooth, intentional motion, including rotation, reveal sequences, and artistic camera paths that serve campaign storytelling.
- Create motion content optimized for digital platforms: TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, digital ads, and brand social channels.
- Develop hero animation sequences for campaign launches and key brand moments.

**Video editing and motion graphics**
- Edit and composite 3D footage into final video deliverables, including color grading, visual effects, and motion graphics using After Effects.
- Add layers of elegance in post-production: light leaks, particle effects, texture overlays, and transitions that elevate the premium feel of each piece.
- Adapt final outputs for different formats and platform specifications without compromising visual quality.

**AI-assisted production**
- Apply AI tools (e.g., Runway, Luma AI, generative texture tools) to accelerate concepting, rendering, and iteration cycles.
- Explore AI-powered workflows that enhance output quality without compromising brand integrity or product accuracy.
- Stay current on tools at the intersection of AI and 3D, and share learnings with the team.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 2–4 years of hands-on experience in 3D modeling, animation, and motion content production.
- Prior experience with jewelry, accessories, or luxury product 3D is a strong advantage. You understand how light interacts with diamond facets, metal surfaces, and translucent stones.
- Proficient in Blender, with a solid command of materials, lighting, and rendering (Cycles, EEVEE, or equivalent render engines).
- Skilled in After Effects for motion graphics, visual effects, color grading, and compositing.
- Strong aesthetic sensibility, with an eye for composition, light, and what makes a frame feel premium.
- Detail-oriented and patient, with the ability to distinguish a render that is good from one that is genuinely beautiful.
- Collaborative and receptive to creative direction, able to work within a brand system while bringing your own craft.
- Experience with AI tools in a 3D or post-production workflow is a plus.
- Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality.
- Basic English reading ability is a plus.

## Benefits

- Salary negotiable based on ability.
- Year-end bonus of up to 3 months' salary, depending on performance.
- Holiday bonuses and individual bonuses for outstanding achievements or valuable contributions to the company's operations and activities.
- Salary review once a year.
- PVI health insurance and annual health check-up.
- Opportunities for development and advancement in the luxury business field.
- Training courses to enhance skills and professional knowledge.
- Company trips, team building, and other company activities.

**Planning and Management**

- Fully participate in sales activities and training programs.
- Manage and maintain relationships with the unit's high-value customer segment.
- Propose and make recommendations to unit leadership on how to develop the unit's high-value customer segment.
- Provide well-founded initiatives and suggestions for customer care and service, aiming to maximize service activities that satisfy customers and exceed their expectations.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

- Proactively manage the portfolio of customers held, track sales results and KPI progress, and maintain maximum productivity.
- Identify and build relationships with high-value customers to sell banking products.
- Manage the portfolio of existing customers and prospective customers.
- Sell, cross-sell, and maximize sales to high-value customers.
- Directly receive customer requests and process customer transactions in compliance with bank regulations.
- Provide customer care in line with bank regulations and requirements to build customer loyalty.
- Work with management to implement business and sales plans.

- Maintain and build a network of high-value customer relationships to grow and expand the priority customer portfolio and maximize cross-selling.

**Education**

- Graduate of a college or university degree or higher in one of the following fields: Banking, Finance, Business Administration, Investment, Insurance, Real Estate, Securities, or other related disciplines.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Economics, Marketing, or Hotel Management is preferred.

**Knowledge and Expertise**

- Good understanding of financial and banking products and services for priority and high-value (individual) customers.
- At least 2 years of experience in banking, finance, investment, or high-end service sectors (such as hotels or tourism).
- Ability to work independently and in coordination with others.
- Broad network and ability to care for high-value customers.

**Skills**

- Strong skills in managing priority customer relationships, building relationships, and developing a high-value customer network.
- Good negotiation, sales, and problem-solving skills.
- Good relationship-building and communication skills.

**Relevant Experience**

- Experience in sales and in caring for high-value customers.

**Competencies**

- Broad and in-depth understanding of products and services for high-value customers.
- Good experience and understanding of investment and insurance products.
- Ability to handle work pressure.
- Professional conduct, with consistent honesty and transparency that earns the trust of leadership and customers.

## Benefits

- Attractive income, with competitive salary and bonuses based on performance.
- Holiday and Tết bonuses (according to bank policy in each period).

- Participation in training courses based on the training framework for each position.
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, and Saturday morning.
- Dynamic, friendly work environment with many opportunities for training, learning, and development, and participation in engaging cultural activities (sports and talent competitions, team-building activities, and more).

**4. Compliance and risk control**

**5. Cross-functional collaboration and leadership advisory**

- Perform other tasks assigned by management.

**Education**

- University degree in a relevant field, such as electrical and mechanical engineering, refrigeration and HVAC, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, or electrical and electronic engineering.

  - Take prospective buyers to view assets, advise them, and guide them through purchasing auction documents and paying deposits.
  - Support buyers who win auctions through contract signing.
- **2.2. Selling mortgaged assets through civil judgment enforcement auctions (Thi hành án, THA):**
  - Meet with enforcement officers (CHV) to discuss sale options and compulsory asset enforcement.
  - Run marketing, post listings, search for buyers, and conduct tele-sales. Filter asset lists and send them to investment partners and brokers in related fields.
  - Take buyers to view assets, advise them, and resolve issues among the parties involved (buyers, sellers, enforcement officers, asset owners, and the enforcement auction sale procedures).
  - Coordinate with debt resolution officers (XLN) and auction companies to help customers purchase auction files and pay deposits.
  - Support buyers who win auctions through contract signing.
  - Coordinate with debt resolution officers, THA, enforcement officers, and winning buyers to develop a plan and carry out asset handover or compulsory enforcement.

- Oversee debt resolution officers in recording debt repayment and processing the release of mortgages so the asset can be handed over to the customer.
- Check and confirm all costs incurred during asset handling, so that debt recovery, advance repayments, and asset-handling expenses are fully and punctually settled.
- Update the system with complete records of the asset sale process.
- Archive files completely and systematically according to the checklist.
- Work with competent state agencies to complete post-sale ownership transfer registration, so customers can quickly and lawfully complete the related procedures for purchased assets.

**4. Other duties and instructions from management**
- Submit periodic reports and operational reports through the Tethys software.
- Perform other tasks assigned by management.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- University or college degree in a field related to Marketing, Business Administration, Banking and Finance, or similar.
- At least 3 years in a role handling or selling mortgaged assets at banks, or 4 years as a sales representative in real estate, automobiles, or similar sectors.
- Experience running online marketing campaigns.
- Planning and organizational skills, with the ability to execute plans.
- Results management skills.
- Communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills.
- Time management skills.
- Risk management skills.
- Relationship building and development skills.
